## p218 A1, p218 A2, p218 A3 — p218 A - Kress, Tiflis and the armistice withdrawal condition

<a id="edition-cases-caucasus-p218-a-p218-a---kress-tiflis-and-the-armistice-withdrawal-condition"></a>


[Source records](../../experiments/corpus_readings/selected_sources.json)

**Records:** p218 A1-A3, three parts of one message dated 25 November 1918.
**Result:** the treaty reference supports a conditional interpretation of
two Nov25–28 numeral cells. It reduces the reading's source cost from
**16 to 13 observed-coordinate substitutions**, with the same three erasure
fills. The two final digits of the opening telegram reference remain unknown.
The message concerns German troops in former Russian territory and the
German guard at Tiflis.

<a id="edition-cases-caucasus-p218-a-most-likely-reading"></a>

### Most likely reading

**Readable German — conditional treaty numeral interpretation:**

> General von Kress, Tiflis. Auf Tel. Nr. 2??. Artikel roem. 12
> Waffenstillstandsvertrages bestimmt: Alle deutschen Truppen, die sich
> gegenwaertig in Gebieten befinden, die vor dem Krieg zu Russland
> gehoerten, haben, sobald die Alliierten unter Beruecksichtigung der
> inneren Lage dieser Gebiete den Augenblick fuer gekommen erachten,
> in die deutschen Grenzen zurueckzukehren.
>
> Die Alliierten haben bisher die Zurueckziehung der deutschen
> Schutzwache aus Tiflis nicht verlangt. Auswaertiges Amt.

The article is XII. The transmitted instruction `ROEM12` expresses that
Roman-number reference; spacing and punctuation are editorial.

**Meaning:** Replying to telegram 163, the Foreign Office informs General
von Kress in Tiflis that the armistice requires German troops in territory
that belonged to Russia before the war to return within Germany's borders
when the Allies judge the moment suitable in light of local conditions.
The telegram adds that the Allies have not yet demanded withdrawal of the
German guard from Tiflis.

The wording identifies **Article XII** in the independently published
[German armistice text](https://germanhistorydocs.org/de/die-weimarer-republik-1918-1933/waffenstillstandsbedingungen-11-november-1918)
and the [U.S. diplomatic documentary edition](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1919Parisv02/d1).
The two received numeral pairs in `RO?MJ1` are complete: `FX` and `VG`.
Reading them as 1 and 2 gives `ROEM12`, after the existing missing `E`
fill. This [conditional shared-square interpretation](../../experiments/nov25_treaty_digits/README.md)
preserves three coordinates that the earlier numeral repair changed.
It also changes the opening raw-label reference `163` to `2??`; its
remaining two values are not established.

The same `FX=1` assignment gives the headquarters designation `AOK11`
in the [Breslau staff order](224.md#edition-cases-people-breslau-staff-transfer) and both
11th-Army addresses in the [crown requests](219.md#edition-cases-finance-crown-cash-requests).
These are consistent consequences of the treaty identification. The
published square, source transcriptions and earlier edition remain intact.

The telegram paraphrases the treaty. The final statement about the Tiflis
guard belongs to this telegram, not to Article XII. No conclusion about a
later withdrawal date is inferred from it.

<a id="edition-cases-caucasus-p218-a-source-route-and-credit"></a>

### Source, route and credit

Printed p218 / PDF p221, heading **25 November 1918**:
`NKJ v LP (02.10 p.m., November 25th); FUER COS 0950 (11/25) 3 TLE`.
The three parts are separately labelled RICHI-282, RICHI-284 and RICHI-278.
Using the established recipient-first header convention, the transmission
is LP to NKJ, for onward delivery to COS. This is an additional Kress-route
record; it does not determine the key or disputed date of [p73](073.md#edition-cases-p73).

The source is J. Rives Childs, *General Solution of the ADFGVX Cipher
System*, in the [public scan](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_JiNMck7eUvdrOTrH7fsj1Yh44t-VSC6/view).
The published period key keeps its external attribution in
[data/keys.json](../../data/keys.json). Source inspection, assembly,
coordinate audit and this annotated edition are by
**icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro**. No first historical decipherment priority
is claimed.

```sh
python3 experiments/corpus_readings/verify.py --verify
```

The [literal source records](../../experiments/corpus_readings/selected_sources.json)
and [certificate](../../experiments/corpus_readings/certificates.json)
include the source PDF hash, reproducible image rectangles, the complete
unchanged key, all raw position domains and both re-encryption checks.

## p218 B2, p218 B3 — Urgent shipping capacity and probable reliance on sea transport

<a id="edition-cases-naval-urgent-shipping-space-urgent-shipping-capacity-and-probable-reliance-on-sea-transport"></a>



**Source review and edition: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.**

The surviving second and third parts request urgent shipping capacity and say that all troops will probably need sea transport. The source explicitly marks the first part missing. Repeated capacity labels, differing command fields and the unresolved source-mask position remain literal.

<a id="source-p218-b2"></a>
<a id="edition-cases-naval-urgent-shipping-space-p218-b2"></a>

### p218 B2

**Source transcription — header:** `B) KOW v RVA (01.36 a.m., November 26th); KR AN LP 2100 (11/25) 3 TLE; (1 TL missing); 2 TL RICHI-188`

<details>
<summary>Source and cipher evidence</summary>

**Raw output — every native source slot in printed order, with non-coordinate glyphs masked:**

```text
SOFORTIGESEGDUNGVONSCHIFFSRAUMFUERJ3YYYMANN3YYYPFERDEXJ3YYYMANN3YYYPFERDEXRTVLDRINGENDGEBOTENX
```

**Edited output — 1 observed-coordinate substitution and 0 source-mask fills; no insertion, deletion or reordering:**

```text
SOFORTIGESENDUNGVONSCHIFFSRAUMFUERJ3YYYMANN3YYYPFERDEXJ3YYYMANN3YYYPFERDEXRTVLDRINGENDGEBOTENX
```

</details>

**Readable German — exact nonseparator labels of the edited output:**

> Sofortige Sendung von Schiffsraum fuer J3YYY Mann 3YYY Pferde. J3YYY Mann 3YYY Pferde. RTVL dringend geboten.

**Meaning:** The surviving second part urgently requests shipping capacity for personnel and horses. The paired capacity labels are repeated in the source. J3YYY, 3YYY and RTVL remain literal; no numerical total or port identification is imposed.

**Editorial limits.**

- The source explicitly says “1 TL missing.” This edition starts with the complete native 188-coordinate second part and supplies no missing first body.
- SEGDUNG to SENDUNG is one observed-coordinate substitution. All source coordinates remain in native order.
- Both repetitions of J3YYY MANN 3YYY PFERDE remain in the exact stream and readable passage. They are not silently converted to familiar decimal numbers or counted as separate telegrams.
- RTVL is not expanded into a named port or headquarters. The printed interception date November 26 and originating line 11/25 remain separate.

<a id="source-p218-b3"></a>
<a id="edition-cases-naval-urgent-shipping-space-p218-b3"></a>

### p218 B3

**Source transcription — header:** `B) KOW v RVA (01.36 a.m., November 26th); KR AN LP 2100 (11/25) 3 TLE; 3 TL RICHI-200`

<details>
<summary>Raw decoded text</summary>

**Raw output — every native source slot in printed order, with non-coordinate glyphs masked:**

```text
DAWAHRSCHEINLICHALLETRUPPENAUFSEETRANSPORTANGEWIESENXGENXKDOX?XBXVX72XGENXKDOXZXBXNX72XJAXNR42XJ2GEH
```

</details>

**Readable German — exact nonseparator labels of the unchanged raw output:**

> Da wahrscheinlich alle Truppen auf Seetransport angewiesen. Gen. Kdo. ? B V 72. Gen. Kdo. Z B N 72. JAXNR42XJ2GEH.

**Meaning:** The third part explains that all troops will probably depend on sea transport. Its command and reference fields remain literal. This is a stated expectation and an urgent request for capacity, not proof that ships were supplied or the troops transported.

**Editorial limits.**

- The native 200-coordinate body contains one printed dash in -AGXG. It remains masked and unfilled; no observed coordinate changes.
- The remaining source-mask position has domain {3, D, F, M, T, X}. A familiar abbreviation is not forced into that field.
- The two command fields retain their different V and N labels, the repeated 72, and the complete footer JAXNR42XJ2GEH. No historical unit identity or numbered reference is inferred.

<a id="edition-cases-naval-urgent-shipping-space-meaning-without-converting-the-labels"></a>

### Meaning without converting the labels

The request concerns transport capacity for men and horses, and the following explanation expects general reliance on sea transport. It does not establish that transport was supplied. Both repetitions of `J3YYY MANN 3YYY PFERDE` are retained. A familiar-looking decimal conversion is not silently applied to the J/Y labels, and RTVL is not expanded to a particular port.

The third-part unknown is a printed source erasure under an otherwise fixed square, with domain `{3, D, F, M, T, X}`. The second command field retains N where the first has V. Both details remain visible rather than being normalized to a standard command abbreviation.

<a id="edition-cases-naval-urgent-shipping-space-evidence-credit-and-reproduction"></a>

### Evidence, credit and reproduction

Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier repository OCR and unchanged-key outputs are retained separately. Source review and explicit editorial work: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.

The certificates independently reconstruct column positions and domains, compare them with the cipher implementation, replay every priced change, and check all readable nonseparator labels. Partial readings have one consistent injective square/source-mask completion witness that re-encrypts exactly; those witness choices are not historical identifications. Source images are bound to the original PDF by page, rectangle, scale, file digest and pixel digest.

Reproduce with `python experiments/urgent_shipping_space/verify.py --verify`. Add `--pdf /path/to/adfgvx-childs.pdf` to check the original PDF and exact source-crop pixels.
